codonPairing.rule: complementary identities (A-U, G-C), fitted base-frame origins <= 2.5 A, antiparallel base normals

registerRule.7ST2: register = author - 19 (chain 4; confirmed by P-site tRNA 5 pairing at author 19-21)

tunnel.algorithm: design 5.6 / PLAN.md 7.4, truncated at the tunnel mouth (recorded deviation from 7.4 step 2)

mouth.rule: first resampled point with arc >= 60 A that is solvent-side (162 rays, 1 A samples, exact clearances, samples beyond 8 A with clearance > 8 A)

tunnel.clearance: exact distance from each stored path point to the nearest 50S heavy atom centre (23S, 5S, L proteins of 7K00; no ions or waters)

notes: Generated by tools/build-assets.mjs (recipe tools/assets/ribosome.mjs) from the mmCIF files pinned in tools/sources.lock.json (model 1, altloc . or A, no hydrogens). Full provenance: docs/assets/ribosome-70s.md.

Ribo frame (PLAN.md 7.3): origin = centroid of C1' of mRNA AUG (7K00 chain X author 16-18); +z toward the centroid of C1' of the A-site codon GUA (author 19-21); +x = component of (centroid of all 23S P atoms - origin) perpendicular to z; +y = z x x. The P- and A-site codons are found by geometric Watson-Crick pairing with the tRNAs, not assumed.

Parts: small = 16S + S2-S21; large = 23S + 5S + L proteins. mRNA, tRNAs and the E-site fragment are excluded from parts, L0, L1 and L2. L1: P beads for RNA (kind 1), CA beads for protein (kind 0). chains[].residues = L1 beads; chains[].modelled = modelled residues.

L0: one envelope per part from all its L1 beads (Gaussian density sigma 5 A, requested spacing 4 A, per-part triangle limit 30000; actual spacing small 4, large 4.5 A); L1 beads inside: small 0.95, large 0.952.

L2 sites decoding 12 A, ptc 12 A: heavy atoms of whole rRNA and protein residues with any atom within the radius of the anchor origin (deduplicated across sites), plus Mg2+ within 8 A of a site origin (chain index = chain of the nearest polymer heavy atom; the entry's auth_asym_id of ions is not used). Bonds by covalent radii inside a residue, plus peptide C-N and phosphodiester O3'-P between consecutive residues.

Site anchors siteA, siteP, siteE and siteAT are the trna frame (trnaFrame in tools/assets/trna.mjs) of the tRNA in the ribo frame, so placing a trna-* asset with an anchor reproduces the source coordinates. See source.siteChecks and source.superpositions.

Superposition (other entries onto 7K00): P atoms of 16S and 23S residues with equal author number and equal residue name, superposeIterative (2.0 A cutoff, two passes). Author numbers are used because the 7ST2 16S label_seq_id is the author number minus one.
siteAP and sitePE are decided by source.siteChecks.hybrid.decision (4.0 A anticodon-origin condition, 16S+23S fit as written in PLAN.md 7.3).

Track mrna: registers -16 to +15, register 0 = first nucleotide of the P-site codon; tracks.mrna.sources gives 7K00, 7ST2 or synthetic per register; synthetic registers are A-form single-strand steps (rise 2.81 A, twist 32.73 degrees about the local z axis) from the nearest fitted register, base N. Anchors mrnaEntry and mrnaExit are frames of registers +15 and -16 and are marked synthetic.
antiSD: centroid of the heavy atoms of 7ST2 16S author 1535-1540 (CCUCCU) after superposition; z = unit vector from C1' of 1535 to C1' of 1540. 7K00 16S ends at 1534.

Path tunnel (starts at the ptc end, residue k at arc length k x 3.40 A, ends at tunnelExit = the tunnel mouth): Dijkstra on a 1 A voxel grid around the 50S (blocked within 3.0 A of any 50S heavy atom; cost = step / clearance squared), three Chaikin passes, resampled at 1.0 A, truncated at the first solvent-side point after 60 A of arc (deviation from PLAN.md 7.4 step 2; the 13 straight-line fallback was rejected because it crosses rRNA); see source.tunnel. Anchors ptc (O3 prime of A76 of the P-site tRNA; z = first path segment) and tunnelExit (last path point; z = last segment).
